description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SEOS-02
**Title:** FAQ questions on E Challan [en] match the stored snapshot
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Compare the FAQ heading and questions on E Challan (en) with the stored snapshot. Pages with no FAQ must still have none.

**Expected Result:**
FAQ heading and questions on E Challan (en) are unchanged.

**Steps:**
1. Open E Challan (en)
2. Read the FAQ block
3. Compare with the stored snapshot
